outcome: poor prognosis in neonates with E. coli or K. pneumoniae BSIs
cohort: 139 neonatal patients with E. coli and K. pneumoniae bloodstream infections were enrolled from January 2017 to December 2023.
finding: Late premature infant status, very low birth weight, cesarean section, pneumonia, and mechanical ventilation were associated with the development of ESBL strains BSI, while hypoalbuminemia and isolation of CRKP were independent predictors of poor prognosis in neonates with E. coli and K. pneumoniae BSIs.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with the development of ESBL strains bloodstream infections.
birth_weight: Very low birth weight, extremely low birth weight
gest_age: Late premature infant, very premature infants
